blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — A businessman was killed in a shooting incident inside the premises of Haifa Palace in Barangay Gadongan, Marawi City, on Tuesday morning, while the two alleged suspects were arrested following a hot pursuit operation, police said. The victim was identified as Daud Ayo Ali, married and a resident of Barangay Gadongan. The arrested suspects were identified as Yahya Tomawis, alias “Pingko,” also a businessman and resident of the same barangay, and Jalil Hadji Malic, a resident of Tagoloan, Lanao del Sur.
